title: Looking down the rabbit hole: Towards quantum optimal estimation of surface roughness
summary: Surface roughness is an important quantity to many engineering and precision manufacturing disciplines. In this paper we investigate the problem of estimating the root-mean-square roughness of a sample by passive linear optics. By adopting quantum parameter estimation methods, we determine the ultimate precision limits for estimating spatial moments of a general three-dimensional distribution of incoherent point sources in the sub-diffraction regime.
